MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Singing games: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Singing games.
   B. Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Singing games.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Singing games.

2. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   D. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

4. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   C. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   D. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
   D. Only the costume

6. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Black, white, and grey

7. Best practice when working on Songs PERFORMING: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Songs PERFORMING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Songs PERFORMING.
   C. Damage equipment used for Songs PERFORMING.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Songs PERFORMING.

8. Best practice when working on Elements of AND RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   B. Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Elements of AND RESPONDING.

9. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.

10. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm COMPOSING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

5. B — The speed of the music

6. B — Red, blue, and yellow

8. B — Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

14. (4 marks)
